recipes.name: Mum's aloo paratha
recipes.source_text: 3 katori atta, 2 big boiled aloo, one onion, hari mirch, masala, and ghee on top, as much as you like.
method: Knead the atta with water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Mash the boiled potato with the onion, green chilli and masala (mix in any cauliflower now).
Roll a small ball of dough, fill with a spoon of stuffing, seal and roll flat.
Cook on a hot tawa, turning once, until brown spots appear.
Brush with a measured half spoon of ghee per paratha at the end, not during cooking.

recipes.name: Sunday rajma chawal
recipes.source_text: 2 katori rajma soaked overnight, 1.5 cups basmati, onion-tomato tadka with adrak lahsun, 2 spoons oil.
method: Pressure-cook the soaked rajma until soft (4-5 whistles).
Heat the oil, fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden, then add tomato and masala.
Add the rajma with some cooking water; simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Rinse and cook the rice (mix in any cauliflower rice in the last 3 minutes).
Serve a measured katori of rice with a big bowl of rajma and salad.

recipes.name: Dal tadka with roti
recipes.source_text: 2 katori toor dal, tamatar, pyaz, lahsun tadka in ghee, 8 rotis from 2.5 katori atta.
method: Pressure-cook the toor dal with turmeric until soft, then whisk smooth.
Make the tadka: heat the ghee, add cumin, garlic, onion and tomato.
Pour the tadka over the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Knead the dough (atta and besan if using), roll thin rotis and cook on a dry tawa.
Serve with salad on the side.

recipes.name: Palak paneer
recipes.source_text: Two bunches palak, 250 g paneer, one onion, one tomato, a spoon of butter and oil.
method: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, cool in cold water and blend smooth.
Heat the oil and butter, fry onion, then add tomato and masala.
Stir in the spinach and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the paneer cubes and warm through; finish with a splash of yogurt if using.

recipes.name: Rice kheer
recipes.source_text: 1 litre doodh, half katori chawal, 1 katori cheeni, a few kaju.
method: Rinse the rice and soak it for 20 minutes.
Bring the milk to a boil, add the rice and simmer on low, stirring, for 30-40 minutes.
Stir in the sugar when the rice is soft; simmer 5 more minutes.
Add the cashews, then serve in small bowls.

recipes.name: Dad's tomato egg stir-fry
recipes.source_text: 4 eggs, 3 tomatoes, a spoon of sugar, 2 spoons soy sauce, spring onion, a little oil.
method: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt; cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Scramble the eggs in half the oil until just set, then set aside.
Cook the tomatoes in the rest of the oil until soft and juicy.
Add the sugar and soy sauce, return the eggs, toss and top with spring onion.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu with rice
recipes.source_text: One block tofu, 200 g pork mince, chili, 3 spoons soy sauce, garlic, ginger, rice for four.
method: Cut the tofu into cubes and blanch in hot water for 2 minutes.
Brown the pork mince with garlic, ginger and chilli.
Add the soy sauce and a little water, then slide in the tofu and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with a measured bowl of rice and a side of greens.

recipes.name: Bok choy with oyster sauce
recipes.source_text: Two bunches bok choy, garlic, 2 spoons oyster sauce, a little oil.
method: Wash the bok choy and halve the larger heads.
Blanch for 1 minute, then drain well.
Fry the garlic in the oil, add the bok choy and toss for 1 minute.
Drizzle the oyster sauce (thinned with a little water) over the top.

recipes.name: Morning congee
recipes.source_text: 1 cup rice cooked soft, ginger, spring onion, a pinch of salt, soy sauce to serve.
method: Rinse the rice and simmer it with plenty of water for about 1 hour, stirring now and then.
Add shredded ginger in the last 10 minutes.
Season lightly; let each person add soy sauce at the table, a few drops at a time.
Top with spring onion.

recipes.name: Nonna's lasagne
recipes.source_text: 500 g beef mince, pasta sheets, tomatoes, a big handful of mozzarella and parmesan, cream for the white sauce.
method: Brown the beef mince (with mushrooms if using) and add the tomatoes; simmer 30 minutes.
Mix the cream (or yogurt) with a little cheese for the white layer.
Layer pasta sheets, meat sauce and white sauce in a dish, three times.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake at 190 °C for 35-40 minutes.

recipes.name: Spaghetti carbonara
recipes.source_text: 400 g spaghetti, 150 g bacon, 3 eggs, parmesan, black pepper.
method: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente; keep a cup of the water.
Crisp the bacon in a dry pan.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and lots of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss the pasta with the bacon, then the egg mix and a splash of pasta water until silky.

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.source_text: Carrot, celery, onion, zucchini, a can of beans, tomatoes, a little pasta, olive oil.
method: Gently fry the onion, carrot and celery in the olive oil for 10 minutes.
Add the zucchini, tomatoes and water; simmer 20 minutes.
Add the beans and the pasta; cook until the pasta is tender.
Season at the end, tasting before adding salt.

recipes.name: Buttered toast and eggs
recipes.source_text: 4 slices white bread, butter, 3 eggs scrambled with a splash of cream.
method: Whisk the eggs with the splash of cream (or milk).
Scramble slowly over low heat with a little butter.
Toast the bread and spread thinly with butter.
Serve with tomato or greens on the side.

recipes.name: Arroz con pollo
recipes.source_text: 2 cups rice, a whole chicken in pieces, peppers, onion, peas, tomato, oil.
method: Brown the chicken pieces in the oil, then set aside.
Fry the onion and peppers until soft, then add the tomato.
Add the rice, the chicken and water; cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the peas for the last 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Black beans and plantains
recipes.source_text: Two cups black beans, 2 ripe plantains fried, onion, garlic, cumin.
method: Simmer the black beans with onion, garlic and cumin for 20 minutes.
Slice the plantains on the diagonal.
Pan-fry the plantains in a little oil, or bake them, until golden.
Serve the beans with the plantains on the side.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
recipes.source_text: 4 flour tortillas, 4 eggs, salsa with tomato and chili, a little queso fresco.
method: Warm the salsa of tomato and chilli in a pan.
Fry or poach the eggs.
Warm the tortillas on a dry pan.
Put an egg on each tortilla, spoon salsa over and crumble the queso on top.

recipes.name: Flan
recipes.source_text: 1 cup sugar for caramel, 4 eggs, milk, condensed milk.
method: Melt the sugar in a pan until amber and pour it into the mould.
Whisk the eggs, milk and condensed milk; pour over the caramel.
Bake in a water bath at 160 °C for about 50 minutes until set.
Chill, then turn out and serve small slices.
